optimized.implementation: 256 KiB buffered streaming reader, 64-event insert batches, sparse RPC/annotation indexes

notes: The benchmark includes JSON decoding, SQLite insertion, eight indexes, semantic views, and atomic staging publication. The timeline query expands only events whose intervals cross bucket boundaries, so long spans contribute to every bucket they overlap rather than only their starting bucket. The old reader passed File directly to serde_json and issued nearly one read syscall per JSON byte. Both import runs used the same release-build host and generated fixture. This is an engineering regression benchmark, not a publication-grade confidence interval.
